prompt: Composition: A low-angle medium shot in the middle of a vibrant pink flower meadow. Capture a vast blue sky to create a bright, open atmosphere. The subject stands in a perfect 90-degree side profile. Body Position: The subject faces away from the camera with her back visible while turning her head over her left shoulder to make direct eye contact with the camera. Her right hand gently wraps around her left shoulder, holding a tiny yellow flower between her fingers. Expression: Dreamy, soft, deep eye contact with the camera. Slightly parted glossy lips create a delicate, mysterious, and ethereal expression. Outfit: Light cream ivory embroidered lace slip dress with an elegant backless design. Thin shoulder straps emphasize a graceful silhouette. Accessories: A small fresh yellow flower ring on the right ring finger. The surrounding pink wildflowers naturally frame the subject throughout the foreground and background. Hair: Long, voluminous dark brown wavy hair falling below the shoulders with soft natural bangs. Fine loose strands gently blow in the breeze. Makeup: Radiant glowing skin under sunlight. Soft neutral eye makeup with subtle eyeliner. Glossy orange-pink coral lips with a hydrated finish. Light Source: Warm late-afternoon direct sunlight coming from the rear-left side. Lighting Effect: Golden rim lighting illuminates the hair, creating a beautiful halo through strong backlighting. Soft diffused frontal light brightens the skin while minimizing harsh shadows, producing a dreamy cinematic atmosphere. Colour Palette: Fairycore aesthetic featuring vibrant blue skies, white clouds, soft ivory fabric, and endless pink wildflowers. Texture: Highly detailed embroidered lace, soft flower petals, silky flowing hair, realistic skin texture, and natural outdoor elements layered with cinematic depth. Angle: Low-angle composition emphasizing the expansive sky and flower field. Lens: Premium prime lens with an ultra-shallow depth of field. Pink flowers in the foreground melt into dreamy foreground bokeh while the subject's face and eyes remain razor-sharp. Location: A vast outdoor meadow stretching to the horizon, completely covered with blooming pink wildflowers. Background: A brilliant blue sky filled with large dramatic white clouds, enhancing the openness and magical fairy-tale atmosphere. Ultra-realistic photography, 8K, RAW, HDR, natural skin texture, cinematic colour grading, photorealistic, premium fashion editorial Aspect ratio 9:16

promptZh: 构图：在 充满活力的粉色花海 中间进行低角度中景拍摄。捕捉广阔的蓝天，营造明亮、开阔的氛围。主体呈完美的 90 度侧面。身体姿态：主体背对镜头，转头越过左肩与镜头进行直接的眼神交流。右手轻轻环绕左肩，指尖捏着一朵 小黄花。表情：梦幻、柔和，与镜头进行深情的眼神交流。微张的亮泽双唇营造出精致、神秘且空灵的表情。服装：浅奶油象牙色刺绣蕾丝吊带裙，优雅的露背设计。细肩带突显优美的轮廓。配饰：右手无名指上戴着一枚小巧的新鲜黄花戒指。周围的粉色野花自然地在前景和背景中衬托出主体。发型：长而蓬松的深棕色波浪卷发垂至肩下，带有柔和的自然刘海。细碎的发丝在微风中轻轻飘动。妆容：阳光下焕发光彩的肌肤。柔和的中性眼妆，搭配精致的眼线。亮泽的橘粉色珊瑚唇，呈现水润质感。光源：来自左后方的温暖午后直射阳光。光影效果：金色的轮廓光照亮发丝，通过强烈的逆光营造出美丽的光晕。柔和的漫射正面光提亮肤色，同时减少生硬的阴影，产生梦幻般的电影感氛围。色调：仙女风审美 (Fairycore aesthetic)，以鲜艳的蓝天、白云、柔和的象牙色面料和无尽的粉色野花为特色。质感：高度细节化的刺绣蕾丝、柔软的花瓣、丝滑飘逸的秀发、真实的皮肤纹理，以及具有电影深度的自然户外元素。角度：低角度构图，强调广阔的天空和花田。镜头：具有超浅景深的高级定焦镜头。前景中的粉色花朵融化成梦幻的前景虚化，而主体的面部和眼睛保持锐利清晰。地点：一片延伸至地平线的广阔户外草甸，覆盖着盛开的粉色野花。背景：明亮的蓝天，点缀着巨大的戏剧性白云，增强了开阔感和神奇的童话氛围。超写实摄影，8K，RAW，HDR，自然皮肤纹理，电影级调色，照片级真实，高级时尚杂志大片，长宽比 9:16
